name: Universal motors (AC/DC brushed)
summary: Brushed motors that run on AC or DC: high-speed motors in drills, blenders, vacuums and saws.
uses: Replacing a dead tool or appliance motor
Running from a generator or inverter
identify: Two carbon brushes rubbing on a copper commutator, in corded drills, angle grinders, blenders, food processors, vacuum cleaners, circular saws and some front-loading washers. They whine loudly at speed.
test: Check the brushes for length and the commutator for burns, then measure continuity through brushes and field.

decay.note: Lasts; brushes are the wear part.
